messages:
devon: Hey team - PR #4852 is blocked, CI keeps failing nondeterministically on telemetry_ingest_integ_test. It passed locally for me twice but the shard failure keeps showing up in Buildkite.
maria: Ugh, saw that. Failing on shard 7 again. Link: https://ci.redwood/example/build/4852
ci-bot: Build 4852 — shard 7 failed: telemetry_ingest_integ_test (timeout)
Logs: /artifacts/4852/shard7/telemetry.log
sam: Can someone try a targeted rerun for shard 7? I don't want to merge until we confirm it's not a real regression. @ryan any chance you can re-run given your bandwidth? :eyes:
ryan: I can kick a rerun in ~20m. If it flakes, we should consider quarantining the test or adding a small sleep in the harness. Quick triage steps: 1) rerun targeted shard 2) search for recent telemetry changes 3) bisect if it keeps failing
devon: For rerun, I usually do: ```bk run --pipeline pr-4852 --shard 7 --targeted``` — that's what I used locally. Also attaching the failing stack snippet: `AssertionError: expected 200 got 503 at ingest_manager.py:214`
maria: 503 from ingestion queue suggests transient upstream throttling. But the timing in the integ looks like nondet setup race sometimes. If rerun passes once, I'm okay with a canary merge and watch the metrics.
sam: If rerun fails again, we should update the snapshot only if it's a deterministic output change — this one is a timeout so snapshot update not appropriate.
ci-bot: Rerun triggered by ryan: https://ci.redwood/example/build/4852/rerun/1 — started
ryan: Rerun finished: shard 7 passed this time. :tada:
devon: Nice. Since it's flaky, can we add a quick comment to the PR describing the flakiness and ask for 2nd approver so merge queue can pick it up? I can add an `/ok-to-merge` note after another approval.
maria: I gave a quick review, left one tiny nits comment. @sam can you give a final LGTM? If yes I can stamp and we can let the merge queue handle the rest.
sam: LGTM — small nit is optional. I would prefer we keep a short note in the test file: `# TODO: investigate occasional 503 on CI; flaky under load` and open a follow-up ticket.
devon: Agreed. I'll add the comment and create a follow-up ticket linking this thread and build logs.
ryan: Also pinging infra to keep an eye on ingestion cluster for the next hour post-merge in case we see correlated 503s (cc @infra). If we see a spike we'll revert.
ci-bot: Merge queued for PR 4852 (will auto-merge after required approvals and green runs).
